# mtconsultancies

> mtconsultancies (Mounatapasvi) is a small software studio based in Bangalore,
> India. It builds custom apps, websites, AI agents and automations for small
> businesses. Every engagement starts with a free discovery call around the
> client's problem, followed by a written proposal. We start from the problem,
> build in early access, and shape features around real feedback.

## Key facts

- Services: custom apps, websites, AI agents, automations
- Location: Bangalore, Karnataka, India
- Process: free discovery call → written proposal → early-access build → handover & support
- Early access: clients try working versions early and shape features from real feedback
- AI agents: trained on client data and connected to their tools, with every step reviewable and visible logs
- Payment: advance to start, milestone payments as agreed in writing
- Contact: Gurushivag@gmail.com, WhatsApp +91 63668 05420

- [AI Agents](https://mtconsultancies.in/ai-agents.html): support, sales and ops agents with transparent logs
